Santa Clara — Lisbon, Portugal

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Santa Clara freguesia includes the Bairro da Ameixoeira, subject of a detailed Publico investigative report (April 2026) describing an entrenched, unresolved drug-dealing scene ('a droga não se resolve, gere-se'), plus a joint PSP mega-operation with neighbouring Alta de Lisboa in November 2025 that seized weapons and drugs and made arrests, and an earlier raid that detained 11 people and seized drugs and firearms (RTP/Sábado). No sources describing daytime street crime, pickpocketing or violent incidents against ordinary residents/tourists were found for Santa Clara specifically, so the concern documented is concentrated around organised drug trafficking rather than general street danger. Sources checked: Publico, 5 Apr 2026 – "Com Furão e Delta na Ameixoeira: 'A droga não se resolve, gere-se. Nunca vai acabar'"; SOL/Sapo, 19 Nov 2025 – "PSP lança megaoperação criminal na Alta de Lisboa e Ameixoeira: Cinco detidos e várias armas apreendidas"; CNN Portugal, 19 Nov 2025 – "Operação policial em curso em Lisboa. PSP faz buscas na Alta de Lisboa e na Ameixoeira"; RTP – "PSP detém 11 pessoas e apreende droga e armas no bairro da Ameixoeira, em Lisboa"; Sábado – "PSP detém 11 pessoas no bairro da Ameixoeira em Lisboa".
